---
name: Missing documentation
about: Suggest a page, section, or example that should exist
title: ''
labels: documentation, enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**What's missing?**
The topic, and what a reader is trying to do when they go looking for it.

**Where would it belong?**
An existing section (Core Concepts, SDK Reference, Examples…), or a new one.

**What should it cover?**
A rough outline is plenty.

**Is it shipped?**
Docs describe what ships. If this covers something not yet released, say so — it
likely belongs on the [roadmap](https://docs.helixid.dev/roadmap) rather than as a
page.

**Would you be up for writing it?**
No obligation — useful to know whether to expect a PR.
